source_review_summary: Worker-2 repaired Table 1 into source-located percent-inhibition rows; worker-4 preserved APD6/DRAMP sequence/activity conflicts instead of smoothing them; worker-6 completed source-reviewed adjudication and retained nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.note: Primary Table 1 reports percent inhibition by conditioned-media total protein, not purified PaDef MIC/MBC; values are preserved without MIC normalization.

Figure 1/PDF text and results support a 47-aa mature sequence starting ATCET..., while APD6/DRAMP linked sequence rows list a 45-aa sequence starting CET...; database rows remain source_conflict or database-only where appropriate.
Linked APD6/DRAMP rows contain anticancer wording; the 2013 primary paper supports antibacterial E. coli/S. aureus activity and a qualitative no-Candida result, not MCF-7 anticancer activity.
Packet supplementary index and extraction status show zero local supplementary assets/tables; the OA package and primary XML/PDF were sufficient for the activity/database rework requested here.
The paper supports antibacterial phenotype and defensin structural context but does not directly assay membrane disruption, target binding, or cell-wall mechanism.
